hero.title:
Building an open future for

agricultural knowledge
hero.description: OpenAgriNet is an open digital ecosystem designed to help institutions make trusted agricultural knowledge accessible to farmers—across languages, regions and channels.

story.title: The story behind <accent>OpenAgriNet</accent>
story.description: OpenAgriNet (OAN) was envisioned to create a more connected, inclusive and resilient agricultural ecosystem by leveraging open, interoperable digital infrastructure. Recognising the need for trusted and accessible digital services for farmers, OAN brings together diverse stakeholders, technologies and capabilities to work as one network. Our goal is to empower farmers with better information, services and opportunities, while enabling a more collaborative and efficient agricultural ecosystem.

inception.title:
From fragmented information

to connected agricultural

intelligence
inception.description: Agricultural knowledge, services and technologies often remain scattered across different platforms, making access difficult for farmers.
inception.p1: OpenAgriNet (OAN) was conceived to bridge this gap by connecting agricultural knowledge, data and services through an open, AI-powered digital network.
inception.p2: It enables farmers to access trusted advice, discover relevant services and take action through simple, natural interactions.
inception.p3: OAN aims to create an open, scalable agricultural ecosystem that can be adopted across regions, institutions and use cases.

team.title: People driving <accent>OpenAgriNet</accent>
team.description:
OAN is being built by a multidisciplinary team bringing together expertise across digital public infrastructure, agriculture, artificial intelligence, technology, ecosystem development and implementation.

Our team works across the network—from architecture and technology to ecosystem partnerships, product development and field implementation.

hero.description: The Open Agriculture Network (OAN) is composed of seven foundational building blocks that together enable farmers, service providers, buyers, government agencies, and ecosystem participants to interact through an AI-powered and interoperable digital infrastructure.
hero.imageAlt: Connected building blocks showing farmland, crops and agricultural services around the OpenAgriNet core

overview.title: One Network, Supporting Every Step
overview.description: These building blocks work together to support the full journey from farmer engagement and advisory services to transaction execution and network participation.

languageAi.title: Language AI
languageAi.description: Enables natural, conversational interactions for farmers across multiple Indian languages, making agricultural knowledge more accessible and inclusive.

authMemory.title: Authentication & Memory
authMemory.description: Manages identity, securely stores farmer and user context, and enables personalised, privacy-preserving experiences across the network.

inferenceAi.title: Inference AI
inferenceAi.description: Uses advanced AI models to interpret agricultural data and knowledge, and provide relevant, reliable and context-aware recommendations.

becknNetwork.title: Beckn Open Network
becknNetwork.description: Enables an open and interoperable digital network for buyers, sellers, service providers and government systems, ensuring fair, inclusive and seamless access to agricultural services.

providerOs.title: Provider OS
providerOs.description: Simplifies onboarding and participation for service providers, agri-input companies, advisory organisations and other ecosystem partners to manage their offerings and engage with the network.

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Provides real-time visibility into system performance, usage patterns and reliability, helping to continuously improve services and deliver better user experiences.

resolver.title: Resolver
resolver.description: Connects user queries and needs to the most relevant services, providers and resources across the network, ensuring that every farmer and stakeholder can easily find the right support.
